title: AgentCommandResponse
description: Client-to-server Jarvis command response. The MCP server renders Instructions as ordered labeled content blocks before ordinary tool content.

Error.description: Existing AgentError discriminated union representation, unchanged.

Instructions.description: Applicable instructions ordered from workspace to project root to deeper directories; empty for no applicable guidance.

Path.description: Workspace-relative source path using '/' separators. No absolute paths.

Content.description: UTF-8 Markdown or a labeled incomplete prefix with original byte counts and full hash. Bounded delivery is enforced by the client, not JSON Schema.
